battle.name: 第一次剛果戰爭
battle.theater: 扎伊爾東部伊圖里省布尼亞周邊
battle.brief: 第一次剛果戰爭於1996年在扎伊爾東部爆發，受烏干達支持的東部叛軍聯盟與扎伊爾政府軍交戰，戰線延伸至基伍與伊圖里地區。英國陸軍此前採行栓動制式步槍Enfield rifle，其於1858年列裝，屬步兵通用武器體系。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: Enfield rifle屬英國陸軍步兵武器體系的制式步槍，供營、連步兵單位的步槍手使用，負責中距離射擊，並與近戰武器及輕武器分工作業。

countries: 1996年至1997年的第一次剛果戰爭，名義上是薩伊（莫布杜治下）與阿非利加剛果民主聯盟（AFDL）之間的內戰，實則是一場在薩伊國土上進行的多國代理戰。真正出兵的是盧安達與烏干達：盧安達以旅級部隊越過魯齊茲河與南部基伍的公路走廊進入薩伊，烏干達人民國防軍（UPDF）以營、連為單位沿伊圖里與卡米納兩個方向推進；布隆迪的CNDD-FDD及ALiR系武裝從側翼進入，牽制薩伊邊防並攻擊加丹加東部據點。薩伊方面的作戰單位是武裝部隊（FAZ），東部各營集中在南基伍的魯特舒魯至卡武穆一線、北基伍的戈馬與薩凱方向，以及伊圖里的布尼亞—馬哈吉—金杜走廊；對東部的補給幾乎全靠卡米納—金沙薩的鐵路與公路。金沙薩與對岸布拉柴維爾是政治樞紐，AFDL的戰略自始至終是同時壓迫東線與鐵路，使金沙薩無法再向東部輸送部隊與彈藥。1996年秋，美國與法國均未出兵，只推動成立聯合國觀察團（UNOMSIL，1996年11月授權、12月開始部署）並逐步加強武器禁運，外交斡旋始終落後於地面行動的節奏。
countriesEn: The First Congo War of 1996 to 1997 was nominally a civil war between Zaire under Mobutu and the Alliance des forces démocratiques pour la libération du Congo (AFDL), but in substance it was a multi-state proxy war fought on Zairean soil. The states that actually sent troops were Rwanda and Uganda: Rwandan brigade-sized formations crossed the Ruzizi river and the road corridor of southern South Kivu into Zaire, while Ugandan People's Defence Force (UPDF) battalions and companies pushed along the Ituri and Kamina axes; Burundian CNDD-FDD and ALiR-linked armed groups entered from the flank, tying down Zairean border units and striking positions in eastern Katanga. On the Zairean side the combatants were the Forces armées zairoises (FAZ), whose eastern battalions were concentrated on the Rutshuru to Kavumu line in South Kivu, on the Goma and Sake axis in North Kivu, and along the Bunia, Mahagi and Kindu corridor in Ituri; almost all resupply to the east ran along the Kamina to Kinshasa railway and the parallel road. Kinshasa and the opposite bank at Brazzaville were the political hinge, and the AFDL strategy from beginning to end was to press the eastern front and the railway at the same time so that Kinshasa could no longer feed troops and ammunition eastward. In the autumn of 1996 neither the United States nor France intervened militarily; they promoted the creation of the United Nations Observer Mission in the DRC (UNOMSIL, authorized in November 1996 and deployed from December) and progressively tightened arms embargoes, while diplomatic mediation consistently lagged behind the pace of the fighting on the ground.
people: AFDL領袖洛朗-德塞雷·卡比拉是薩伊內陸出身的商人與前低階軍官，他的做法不是重建一套參謀體系，而是把欠薪逃亡的FAZ士兵、加丹加地區的老兵，以及少數盧安達與烏干達顧問拼成他口中所說的「廢墟中的軍隊」，指揮鏈靠營長之間面對面的約束維持。AFDL的軍事骨幹包括前FAZ軍官奧諾雷·恩班達，他放棄軍階投奔卡比拉，統率東線突擊；馬塞爾·利豪以卡比拉姻親兼前軍人身分在卡武穆一帶協調進攻；讓-皮埃爾·本巴則指揮卡米納至金沙薩鐵路與伊圖里方向的縱隊。薩伊方面，莫布杜把國軍當作私人資源，FAZ高層缺少能連續指揮整場戰役的人，師級單位各自為戰，軍官滯留後方補給線，士兵因欠薪大批逃亡。盧安達方面，總統帕斯泰爾·比齊姆加只是象徵，真正決定邊境作戰的是副總統兼國防部長保羅·卡加梅，他以嚴格的營級調度、縱隊速度與後方管制投入數個旅；烏干達的約韋里·穆塞韋尼則把介入當成對付莫布杜的區域政治，據多方說法以第二師與第四師所屬營連為主力，由艾利·卡揚加在前線協調。1996年7月支持布隆迪CNDD-FDD政變企圖的薩伊軍方人物，則是把哈圖武裝引進薩伊的關鍵中介。
peopleEn: The AFDL leader Laurent-Désiré Kabila was a businessman and former junior officer from the Zairean interior, and his method was not to build a new staff system but to assemble unpaid FAZ deserters, Katangese veterans and a handful of Rwandan and Ugandan advisers into what he called an army of ruins, with a chain of command sustained by face-to-face authority between battalion commanders. The military backbone of the AFDL included Honoré Ngbanda, a former FAZ officer who abandoned his commission to join Kabila and who ran the eastern thrust; Marcel Lihau, Kabila's in-law and a former serviceman, coordinated the drive in the Kavumu area; and Jean-Pierre Bemba, who commanded the long column along the Kamina to Kinshasa railway and into Ituri. On the Zairean side Mobutu treated the army as a private resource. The FAZ senior command lacked anyone able to command the whole war continuously, divisional units fought separately, officers lagged behind the supply lines, and unpaid soldiers deserted in large numbers. On the Rwandan side President Pasteur Bizimungu was a figurehead; the border war was shaped by Vice President and Defence Minister Paul Kagame, who committed several brigades with strict battalion-level rotation, column speed and rear-area control of supplies. Yoweri Museveni regarded the intervention as regional politics directed at Mobutu and, according to multiple accounts, committed mainly battalion and company elements of the Second and Fourth Divisions, with Elly Kayanja coordinating on the frontier. The Zairean officers who backed the CNDD-FDD coup attempt against Burundi in July 1996 were the intermediaries who brought Hutu armed groups into Zaire.
kits: AFDL與其外軍支援者最常見的步槍是蘇制AK-47、AKM、中國製56式與SKS；通用機槍以PKM、DP-28及蘇制12.7毫米DShK、NSV為主，烏干達營常配56式衝鋒槍。對地火力靠RPG-7與PG-7系列火箭彈，配81毫米及82毫米迫擊砲，部分部隊另有120毫米迫擊砲。FAZ的裝備更舊更雜：口徑122毫米以上的榴彈砲數量有限，另有BM系列多管火箭砲，固定在陣地上射擊；履帶車輛約數十輛，含蘇制T-34、PT-76與中國製59式，另有裝甲運兵車與重型卡車。空中力量只屬於FAZ，少量米格-21戰鬥機與米-8、米-17直昇機用於偵察與低空掃射，但談不上制空；AFDL與盧安達沒有戰鬥機，只能以12.7毫米高射機槍與9K31箭-2便攜式防空系統反制，實戰中FAZ飛機多被逼離低空，箭-2在兩側都出現，多半是從FAZ軍械庫繳獲。通訊靠手持VHF／UHF電台與鐵路沿線的固定電話線，AFDL攻入後繳獲大量AK-47、迫擊砲與12.7毫米機槍彈藥，但缺乏備件、燃料與正規後勤車隊，不少戰利品無法使用。
kitsEn: The most common rifles in the hands of the AFDL and its foreign supporters were the Soviet AK-47 and AKM, the Chinese Type 56 and the SKS. General purpose machine guns were mainly the PKM, the DP-28 and the Soviet 12.7 mm DShK and NSV, with Ugandan battalions often carrying Type 56 submachine guns. Anti-personnel fire came from RPG-7 and PG-7 series rockets with 81 mm and 82 mm mortars, and some units also carried 120 mm mortars. FAZ equipment was older and more heterogeneous: there were only a handful of guns above 122 mm, together with BM-series rocket launchers emplaced in fixed positions; tracked vehicles numbered in the dozens, including Soviet T-34 and PT-76 and Chinese Type 59, plus armoured personnel carriers and heavy trucks. Air power belonged to the FAZ alone, with a small number of MiG-21 fighters and Mi-8 and Mi-17 helicopters used for reconnaissance and low-level strafing, though it amounted to no air superiority at all. The AFDL and the Rwandans had no fighters and could only answer with 12.7 mm anti-aircraft machine guns and 9K31 Strela-2 manpads, and in practice FAZ aircraft were pushed away from low altitude. Strela-2 appeared on both sides, mostly captured from FAZ depots. Communications ran on handheld VHF and UHF radios and on fixed telephone lines along the railway; after the advance the AFDL seized large stocks of AK-47s, mortar rounds and 12.7 mm ammunition, but without spare parts, fuel and a regular logistic vehicle fleet much of it went unused.
tactics: AFDL與盧安達、烏干達部隊的做法接近正規化的邊境突襲加上車隊縱隊。典型程序是：以兩三百人為單位搭乘卡車與技術車（皮卡加焊機槍座），沿唯一公路夜間行進，白晝停在小村與林緣偽裝；先鋒以徒兵與工兵在黎明前搜索路肩與兩側草叢，遇到FAZ哨所即以機槍與迫擊砲壓制，奪下路口與渡口後才讓後續車隊通過；連級單位之間以電台約定時間與信標。盧安達部隊特別強調速度與紀律，把進攻縱隊保持在距前線十至二十公里內，由後方倉庫（魯特舒魯、卡米納、金杜）以卡車輸送燃料與口糧。FAZ採靜態防禦：卡武穆與魯特舒魯外圍挖壕、堆沙袋、架12.7毫米機槍，據報通往卡武穆的接近路有地雷，部分城市街道以車輛與瓦礫堵塞；但指揮部與連隊之間的電話線常被切斷，欠薪士兵成批帶槍離隊，防守單位一旦被側翼突破就整批潰散。AFDL刻意切斷卡米納—金沙薩的鐵路，把兵力分成東線與西路兩支，迫使FAZ在兩線之間分兵；1997年5月中旬的卡武穆巷戰因地雷與街壘而傷亡慘重，城市最終仍被奪下。
tacticsEn: The AFDL and its Rwandan and Ugandan forces fought in a manner close to a regularized border assault combined with motorized columns. The typical sequence was this: groups of two or three hundred men rode in trucks and technicals, pickups with welded machine-gun mounts, along the single usable road, moving at night and hiding by day in small villages and at the edge of the brush. The advance guard searched the verges and the grass on both flanks before dawn, and when it met an FAZ outpost it pinned it with machine-gun and mortar fire and only then let the following vehicle column through. Company units coordinated timing and rendezvous points by radio. The Rwandan formations put particular emphasis on speed and discipline, keeping the striking column within ten to twenty kilometres of the front and supplying fuel and rations by truck from rear depots at Rutshuru, Kamina and Kindu. The FAZ defended statically: trenches and sandbagged 12.7 mm machine-gun positions outside Kavumu and Rutshuru, reported minefields on the approaches to Bukavu, and barricades of vehicles and rubble across some city streets. Communications by telephone between headquarters and companies were repeatedly cut, unpaid soldiers left in batches carrying their weapons, and defensive units dissolved as a body once their flank was turned. The AFDL deliberately severed the Kamina to Kinshasa railway and split its strength between an eastern and a western axis to force the FAZ to divide. The street fighting for Bukavu in mid-May 1997 was costly because of mines and barricades, and the city nevertheless fell.
data: 可核對的數字有限，且多為估算。AFDL在1996年3月興兵時只有數千名FAZ逃兵，到1997年春估計膨脹到五萬至八萬人，說法從不足五萬到逾十萬不等。盧安達投入的部隊常被估為數千至約一萬人，烏干達第一批部隊約六千至一萬人。FAZ全國紙上兵力在五萬至十萬之間，可調往東部的地面部隊僅約一萬至兩萬，欠薪與逃亡使實際戰鬥力更低。傷亡沒有可信總數：卡武穆、卡米納的巷戰與魯特舒魯一役的死亡人數，在聯合國與非政府組織報告中多以數百人描述，個別數字無法查證，本篇不作精確引述。1996年下半年，約六十萬至八十萬盧安達人自薩伊返回或越境進入盧安達；1997年7月17日尼拉貢戈火山噴發，造成約二十五萬人流離失所。這些數字顯示，戰爭的主要消耗不是會戰，而是人力崩解與補給瓦解。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are limited and most are estimates. When the AFDL took up arms in March 1996 it had only a few thousand FAZ deserters; by the spring of 1997 it is estimated to have swollen to between fifty thousand and eighty thousand men, with accounts ranging from under fifty thousand to more than one hundred thousand. Rwandan forces committed are usually estimated at several thousand to about ten thousand, and the first Ugandan contingent at roughly six thousand to ten thousand. FAZ paper strength nationwide was between fifty thousand and one hundred thousand, but only about ten thousand to twenty thousand ground troops could be moved east, and arrears and desertion cut their real fighting power further. There is no reliable aggregate casualty figure. Deaths in the street fighting at Bukavu and Kamina and in the fighting for Rutshuru are described in United Nations and non-governmental reports in terms of hundreds, with individual numbers unverifiable, and no precise figure is quoted here. In the second half of 1996 some six hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand Rwandans returned from Zaire or crossed into Rwanda; the eruption of Nyiragongo on 17 July 1997 displaced about two hundred and fifty thousand people. These figures show that the main consumption of the war was not battle casualties but the disintegration of manpower and of supply.
cause: 起因是三層問題疊加。第一，1994年盧安達大屠殺後，哈圖武裝在薩伊東部建立基地，越境襲擊與軍火走私使雙邊安全無法維持；第二，薩伊軍方欠薪已久，1996年3月卡米納守軍的兵變成為AFDL的起點，反莫布杜聯盟由此而生；第三，莫布杜政府長期庇護哈圖流亡武力並支援1996年7月布隆迪CNDD-FDD推翻布隆迪政府的企圖，使盧安達與布隆迪反對派都把薩伊視為不可信的邊境。點火的是1996年9月底至10月初的邊界衝突：盧安達部隊追擊越境武裝進入薩伊境內，FAZ在魯齊茲河與盧旺度一帶抵抗，盧安達以優勢兵力反擊並越界追擊，把原本的地方性衝突擴大成全面戰爭。國際反應慢了半拍，歐洲與美國的禁運措施在軍事物資仍從外部流入時才生效，聯合國的調解沒有強制力，戰爭因而拖成曠日持久的消耗戰。
causeEn: The causes were the product of three overlapping problems. First, after the 1994 genocide in Rwanda, Hutu armed groups established bases in eastern Zaire, and cross-border incursions and arms trafficking made bilateral security impossible to maintain. Second, the Zairean army had gone unpaid for a long time, and the mutiny of FAZ troops at Kamina in March 1996 became the starting point of the AFDL and of the anti-Mobutu alliance. Third, the Mobutu government long sheltered Hutu exile forces and backed the July 1996 CNDD-FDD attempt to overthrow the Burundian government, so that Rwanda and the Burundian opposition alike treated Zaire as an untrustworthy frontier. The trigger was the border clash of late September and early October 1996: Rwandan troops pursuing armed men across the border entered Zairean territory, the FAZ resisted in the Ruzizi river and Uvira area, and Rwanda counterattacked with superior strength and pursued across the border, turning a local clash into a general war. The international response lagged by half a beat. European and American embargo measures only took effect while military material was still flowing in from outside, United Nations mediation had no enforcement power, and the war accordingly dragged on as a protracted war of attrition.
impact: 最深遠的影響發生在軍隊與國家層面。FAZ作為一支能作戰的軍隊實際解體：東部各營瓦解，士兵帶走武器成為武裝團體，大批裝甲與重武器因缺油、缺備件淪為廢鐵；卡比拉接收了這些人與裝備建立新軍，但新軍同樣沒有後勤傳統。區域方面，武器從薩伊軍械庫大量外流，流入盧安達、烏干達與布隆迪的武裝團體，並在伊圖里催生彼此火拼的五月黨式武裝；FAZ的崩潰也讓剛果河下游失去緩衝，戰事從邊境戰爭轉為對首都的爭奪。莫布杜在1997年7月4日AFDL進入金沙薩後被幽禁於總統府，其後流亡，1999年客死摩洛哥；卡比拉同年12月17日宣誓就任國家元首，1998年5月17日國號正式改為剛果民主共和國，薩伊時期的國家框架消失。更危險的是戰爭未在形式上終止：AFDL內部因本巴另立門戶而分裂，1998年8月盧安達與烏干達再度出兵，第二場剛果戰爭隨即爆發，戰場轉入伊圖里與剛果河兩岸。
impactEn: The deepest effects were felt at the level of armies and of the state. As a fighting force the FAZ effectively dissolved: the eastern battalions broke up, soldiers walked away with their weapons to form armed groups, and large stocks of armour and heavy equipment turned into scrap for want of fuel and spare parts. Kabila took both the men and the equipment and built a new army, but that army likewise had no logistic tradition. Regionally, weapons flowed out of Zairean depots into armed groups in Rwanda, Uganda and Burundi, and in Ituri they fed the rise of rival Mayi-Mai style formations. The collapse of the FAZ also removed the buffer for the lower Congo basin, and the war turned from a frontier struggle into a contest for the capital. After the AFDL entered Kinshasa on 4 July 1997, Mobutu was confined to the presidential palace, later went into exile and died in Morocco in 1999. Kabila was sworn in on 17 December 1997, and on 17 May 1998 the country's official name became the Democratic Republic of the Congo, dissolving the framework of the Zairean period. More dangerous was the fact that the war did not end in form: the AFDL split as Bemba went his own way, and in August 1998 Rwanda and Uganda intervened again, opening the Second Congo War with the fighting shifting to Ituri and the two banks of the Congo river.
result: 結果是看得見的軍事勝利落在AFDL手上。1996年10月下旬魯特舒魯易手，卡武穆—戈馬公路被切斷；1997年5月16日卡武穆淪陷，5月19日基桑加尼淪陷，同月AFDL部隊抵達布拉柴維爾並渡過剛果河；7月4日部隊進入金沙薩，莫布杜政權終結；11月1日戈馬落入AFDL與盧安達部隊之手。AFDL控制首都後改組國家機器，卡比拉於1997年12月17日宣誓就任，國名在1998年改稱剛果民主共和國。但勝利未帶來穩定：占領軍隊分屬卡比拉與本巴兩派，東部的伊圖里衝突自1998年夏天起失控，盧安達與烏干達的第二次介入把戰爭拉長成1998至2003年的第二次剛果戰爭，直到1999年7月10日盧柴瓦停火協議才建立過渡框架。第一次剛果戰爭的實質成果因此是：莫布杜的薩伊國家被推翻並解散，卡比拉的武裝聯盟取得政權，而同一支聯盟與其盟友之間的戰爭隨即接管了前線。
resultEn: The visible military victory went to the AFDL. Rutshuru changed hands in late October 1996, cutting the Bukavu to Goma road; Bukavu fell on 16 May 1997, Kisangani on 19 May, and that same month AFDL troops reached Brazzaville and crossed the Congo river; on 4 July they entered Kinshasa and the Mobutu regime ended; on 1 November Goma fell to AFDL and Rwandan forces. Having taken the capital, the AFDL reorganized the machinery of state, Kabila was sworn in on 17 December 1997, and the country was renamed the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 1998. But victory brought no stability. The occupying forces split between Kabila's and Bemba's factions, fighting in the east of Ituri ran out of control from the summer of 1998, and the second intervention by Rwanda and Uganda stretched the conflict into the Second Congo War of 1998 to 2003, with a transitional framework only established by the Lusaka Ceasefire Agreement of 10 July 1999. The substantive outcome of the First Congo War was therefore this: the Mobutu state of Zaire was overthrown and dissolved, Kabila's armed alliance took power, and the war between that same alliance and its own allies immediately took over the front line.
